name: Authentic Self-Presentation
purpose: Present enough of one's actual preferences, needs, values, and responses for relational fit to be evaluated.
logic: NOT 'be more vulnerable so you can be chosen.' Discernment requires sufficiently accurate information about BOTH people; excessive self-editing reduces the quality of that information.
role: Provides accurate self-information (the input to Discernment).
status: APPROVED — resolves the previously-held CP-06/C1 application.

name: Reciprocity-Based Investment
comp: Role Functioning → Reciprocity; Trust → Availability, Congruence
purpose: Adjust investment according to demonstrated reciprocity, availability, and consistency rather than increasing pursuit or remaining oriented primarily toward whether one is being selected.
logic: Governed cross-cluster evidence (Tier 2). Consolidates STM-0395 + STM-0042 with the developmentally TRANSLATED observation component of STM-1039 (observe consistency in Exploration — not Exclusivity commitment-promises).
role: OBSERVATION component — gathers and interprets relational evidence.

name: Evidence-Informed Decision-Making
purpose: Use accumulated relational evidence to determine whether to continue, deepen, slow, or discontinue investment rather than remaining indefinitely in open-ended waiting.
logic: Condition-based (NO arbitrary calendar timelines). Distinct from T2: T2 gathers/interprets evidence; T3 uses sufficient evidence to make an investment decision.
role: DECISION component — acts on sufficient relational evidence.

name: Intentional Dating Break
purpose: Distinguish a chosen rest from avoidant withdrawal when dating fatigue/burnout is present.
logic: TRIGGER-GATED: relevant only when dating fatigue/burnout is present. Do NOT assume every Cluster 1 user needs a dating break; it is not a universal response to Difficulty Feeling Chosen.
role: Context-activated — outside the PRESENT→OBSERVE→DECIDE primary sequence.

name: Do not dismiss available people before checking
logic: RULING: developmental-task relevance ALONE is insufficient for cross-cluster admission. Its center of gravity is partner SELECTION, not Difficulty Feeling Chosen; C1-specificity insufficient.
status: HELD / NOT ADMITTED — preserved as precedent that task-relevance alone does not qualify.

name: Red-flag checking
logic: Fails Rule 2 (semantic-only) + Rule 7 (materiality); belongs to self-trust (C5), C1 never states it.
